answer: Written in a bullet-like short clauses, then a summary line register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the basalt of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors.
